name: Delivery & Customer Success {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Fulfil the promise, drive adoption, earn the renewal.

commands.name: /delivery
commands.returns: Health per engagement, outstanding promises, and decisions that are due.

commands.name: /handoff-client
commands.does: Runs the sales to delivery transfer.
commands.returns: An itemised promise register with a scope verdict per promise.

commands.name: /onboard-client
commands.returns: A plan with a first value date and named owners on both sides.

commands.name: /success-plan
commands.does: Defines outcomes and measures with the customer.
commands.returns: The customer's own measures, baselines and targets, agreed in writing.

commands.name: /client-plan
commands.returns: Milestones with acceptance criteria, cadence and decision rights.

commands.name: /client-update
commands.returns: An unsent update stating risk with options before the deadline.

commands.name: /scope-change
commands.does: Processes a change request outside agreed scope.
commands.returns: A priced change or a stated refusal, never silent absorption.

commands.name: /client-risk
commands.returns: The escalation path, the specific ask, and the point of no return.

commands.name: /adoption
commands.returns: An intervention with a measurable target and a review date.

commands.name: /value-proof
commands.returns: Attributed value, plus an explicit list of what cannot be attributed.

commands.name: /qbr
commands.returns: A review built on the success plan measures and the value proof.

commands.name: /renew-client
commands.returns: A recommendation with its signals, sent to Revenue {OS} to decide.

commands.name: /case-study
commands.does: Requests consent and builds a case study.
commands.returns: Scoped written consent, then a draft the customer sees first.

commands.name: /offboard
commands.returns: A handover pack, data control returned, and the learning captured.

handoffs.artifact: the signed commitment and every promise made in the sale

requires_human_approval_for: sending any customer-facing update, on the exact text
publishing a case study, with the customer's written consent and prior review
recording a deliverable as accepted without customer evidence
sending a renewal recommendation that diverges from the health signals
offboarding a customer or deleting their data
